items.description: Pixaquote is a mobile app which allows you to discover thousands of great quotes and embed those quotes in photos to design your own unique images! You can use photos from your own device or search a vast online database of high-quality royalty free photos to use in your creation. Share your favorite quotes and your creations via email, text, or social media.

Pixabay is a website where users can browse through and download high quality photos, vector graphics and art illustrations that are all license free. Pixabay hosts a RESTful API interface for querying and retrieving these CC0 public domain images from Pixabay's directory of over 260,000 photos. The API can be accessed via HTTP address, and returns in JSON unicode. The API is limited to a maximum of 300 search results per query, and requires an API key for access.
View a map that uses custom map types to create a 3D stylized map of Hong Kong.
Foreign markets and major US sector watch list gadget for iGoogle.
Fishing hotspots, charters and accommodation from around the world on Google Maps. User-generated content. Add your own locations.
Search and view automotive YouTube videos by car make and model. Search used cars using the new Photo Lot.
UKBirdMap is a Google Map of bird sightings reported via Twitter. Tweets with the hashtag #ukbirdcount, a UK postcode and the species of bird spotted are automatically added to the map in real-time.

Viator sells tours and activities through their website, eight local-language sites serving European and Japanese markets, and more than 2,000 affiliated sites that include major hotel chains and airlines, online travel agencies, city-specific sites and more. Viator makes it's database of products available as XML. Developers can use the XML to display Viator products on their website as well as in confirmation emails for bookings conducted for other services. Full documentation is not available.
Mashup with searchable US Golf Courses, weather data and details golf course information.
Smartinsurance.sg is a new car insurance comparison site that makes it extremely easy for you to compare singapore car insurance prices online.
Good way to visualize trends via the NY Times by comparing two keywords for number of article mentions over time.

Stat!Ref is a virtual source of healthcare information in a wide variety of medicine fields. Stat!Ref invites developers to use their API to show a search bar with their information on a new site. The API is about healthcare information. To create an application, developers have access to RSS 2.0 and Atom 1.0 formats. The required parameters are searchTerms and grpalias. Some of the optional parameters include startIndex, count, sr:titleList and format. In the site, developers can find examples for queries and error handling. Developer support available.
Generates a profile image for your unique Facebook ID. Can be posted to the Wall and Profile page. Shows how all your friends look like as Retro Avatar.
Find mashed up maps in your locale: city, state, country, or the world, sorted by categories. Updated daily with your suggestions.
Google Apps and Box.net are integrated, so Google Apps users can access their Box files from within Gmail, create file-based events in Google Calendar, and create Google Sites with content from Box.
Kangxi Radicals is an app to identify up to a thousand Chinese characters. The application uses the Forvo API to help with pronunciation.
A fun method to learn and improve your foreign languages like English, French or Italian through music and typing-in song lyrics.
Map of wine shops in New York City. With brief summaries and links to their web sites.
Map of the main players in Silicon Valley like Google, Yahoo, Facebook, eBay and many others. Via Valleywag.
eBooksDoc brings together a community of word lovers. In our site you will be able to find any kind of documents and official manuals (pdf, txt, word, ppt, etc), books and eBooks.
An interactive guide to downtown Ferndale, Michigan built on the Google Earth Plug-In. It incorporates layered content from the business community, municipality and the local historical society.
Create your tweets and post them at any future date and time.
